items.html: For before this, Aba was entirely MaH and Ima entirely BaN. And now that they have been exchanged and mingled, as above, therefore upon their entry within ZA, it is found that the portion of Hochma and Hesed of Aba is given to the male MaH within ZA; and likewise the portion of Hochma and Hesed of Ima, which are also the aspect of MaH, as mentioned. But the Bina and Gevura of Aba and the Bina and Gevura of Ima are given to the Nukva side within ZA himself, called the Malchut in his own body.
